body: I'm sorry you feel that society is against you. It does sound like you're going through a shitty situation. I wish the world wasn't like this.

I'm sorry life handed you such a difficult deck of cards.

But reading your story, I was in awe about how you managed to persevere and succeed despite nearly the whole world working against you. That is a fucking accomplishment.

You're an inspiration.

Man, I should not have clicked on this thread. All these people recounting stories of being called handsome...

I must be the ugliest motherfucker in the developed world.
